title: Targeted sequencing of ampliconic gene transcripts from total human male testis RNA
protocol: Add 0.1 volume of 5 M Ammonium Acetate to 5-50 ug of testis RNA.
Add 1 μL Glycogen.
Add 2.5 volumes of 100% ethanol.
Mix thoroughly by vortexing.
Precipitate at –20°C overnight.
Recover the RNA by centrifugation at 12,000 x g for 30 min at 4° C.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Centrifuge the tube briefly and aspirate away any additional fluid.
Add 1 mL 70% ethanol, and vortex the tube a few times.
Repellet the RNA by microcentrifuging for 10 min at 4°C.
Add a unique PacBio barcode to the forward primer.
Add a unique PacBio barcode to the reverse primer.
Perform Gradient PCR on human testis cDNA using annealing temperatures ranging from 55°C to 68°C.
Separate RT-PCR products with electrophoresis on a 0.8% agarose gel.
Visualize bands on the agarose gel under UV light.
Determine the optimal annealing temperature for each multigene transcript family based on distinct band patterns.
Perform final PCR amplifications using the specific annealing temperatures determined.
Purify RT-PCR products using AMPure XP beads.
Prepare RT-PCR products for PacBio sequencing.
Pool equimolar amounts of RT-PCR products specific to each multigene family that are less than 1 kb in size to a total amount of 2 ug.
Prepare one PacBio SMRTbell library from the pooled RT-PCR products.
Sequence the prepared library using one SMRT cell with PacBio’s Procedure & Checklist – Isoform Sequencing (Iso-Seq) using the Clontech SMARTer PCR cDNA Synthesis Kit and No Size Selection.
Pool equimolar amounts of RT-PCR products specific to each gene family that are between 1 kb and 2 kb in size to a total amount of 2 ug.
Prepare one PacBio SMRTbell library from the pooled RT-PCR products.
Sequence the prepared library using one SMRT cell with PacBio’s Procedure & Checklist – Isoform Sequencing (Iso-Seq) using the Clontech SMARTer PCR cDNA Synthesis Kit and No Size Selection.
Construct Nextera XT libraries from the same RT-PCR products used for PacBio sequencing.
Pool equal volumes of bead-normalized Nextera XT libraries.
Sequence the pooled libraries on a MiSeq instrument using one MiSeq Reagent Nano Kit, v2 (250x250 paired-end sequencing).
